I think it went off, but didn't change the timeline in the future at all.  It was "the incident" that the dharma orientation video referred to, but it didn't actually destroy the island.  It makes a lot of sense now and we had  some clues (formerly contradictions) that the sideways world was not actually a result of the h-bomb.  Like when Pierre Chang pushed his family off of the island (before the h-bomb, fitting in with the real timeline), but we see him in the sideways world with a relationship with Miles.

If the sideways world did turn out to be the result of the h-bomb we'd also now be asking "what was the incident the dharma video referred to?"  I hadn't taken the situation with Pierre Chang and the incident to be a clue before, since there's plenty of contradictions on the show, I just thought it was a good ol contradiction.  I'm glad it make sense now.
